title: Trump departs for Philippines to attend ASEAN summit

blocks.text: US President Donald Trump gestures, as he boards Air Force One en route to Manila, Philippines, at Joint Base Andrews, Maryland, US, November 16, 2026. REUTERS/Carlos Barria

US President Donald Trump departed Washington on Monday (November 16) for a trip to Asia that includes an ASEAN summit in the Philippines and a visit to China, where he said he might meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.
Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent also joined Trump on the trip, boarding Air Force One with him at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland.
Speaking to reporters before his departure, Trump said a possible meeting with Kim would take place in China and depend on Chinese President Xi Jinping.

Trump also said he expected to meet Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin during the trip, with potential discussions covering Russia's war in Ukraine, nuclear nonproliferation and the war in Iran. — Reuters
